Prediction Markets Face Scrutiny Over Game Integrity and Swap Definitions

The National Football League (NFL) has warned the Supreme Court that prediction markets pose a threat to the integrity of games. Concurrently, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has proposed expanding the definition of swaps to encompass trading on prediction markets. The Financial Times explored the broader concept of prediction markets' wisdom.
